investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Calderon Freight; Platform: on-premises Kubernetes cluster cf-prod with an Istio service mesh (mTLS STRICT), node range 10.44.0.0/16; Certificates: workload certificates are signed by istiod using an intermediate CA certificate that cert-manager obtains from a Vault PKI issuer and must renew before expiry; Change management: CHG- identifiers.
